abhts_22.17.literal: Now (atha) in-couple (yāmale): of-power (śakter) mark (lakṣaṇam) this (etat) — like-it (tadvad) nondifference (abhedas) then (tato) without-regard (anapekṣya) age-and-the-rest (vayaḥ jātyādīṃś ca) non-attachment (asaṅgāt); of-other-than-world-couple-born (loketarayugalajaṃ hi) identity (tādātmyam)

abhts_22.21.literal: By-each-own-enjoyment-non-enjoyment-variety (nijanijabhogābhogapravikāsa- mayasvarūpaparimarśe); gradually (kramaśaḥ) subcircle-goddesses (anucakradevyaḥ) consciousness-circle (saṃviccakraṃ hi) middle (madhyamaṃ) go (yānti)
